title: 第十三章 清泉镇和“绿洲“有秘密通讯-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    ## 一、风声

    凌晨四点，林霜被一阵轻微的响动惊醒。

    她睁开眼睛，在黑暗中躺了几秒钟，然后坐起来。她看了一眼旁边——苏琳和赵小禾还在睡，张小梅不在。张小梅的睡铺是空的，砍刀也不在墙上。

    林霜拿起弩，轻手轻脚地走出厂房，爬上屋顶。

    张小梅站在屋顶的女儿墙后面，手里拿着望远镜，正朝北面看。她的右膝微微弯曲，不敢完全站直，那是旧伤留下的习惯性姿势。

    “看到什么了？“林霜走过去。

    “矿区的灯全灭了。“张小梅把望远镜递给她，“不是几盏，是全部。从昨天晚上十点开始，一盏一盏地灭，到现在彻底黑了。“

    林霜用望远镜看了看。北面的地平线上，原本那片像小镇一样的黄色灯光区域，现在变成了一片漆黑。只有在矿区入口的方向，偶尔有一闪一闪的光——像是手电筒或者车灯在移动。

    “他们在搞什么？“张小梅放下望远镜，“又不是停电。他们有发电机。“

    “也许是在搞演习。“林霜说，“也许是在转移什么人。也许——他们发现了什么，在加强隐蔽。“

    “我们要不要提前行动？“

    “不。计划不变。今天你去自由集市——不，我自己去自由集市。你带人去矿区外围侦察，但不要靠近，远远地看。天黑之前回来。“

    张小梅看了她一眼：“你一个人去自由集市？那边人多嘴杂，万一遇到收割者的眼线——“

    “所以我一个人去。一个人目标小，跑得快。“林霜把望远镜还给张小梅，“你带着赵小禾和王芳去北边。赵小禾的左肩还在恢复，但走路爬坡没问题。王芳负责背物资。“

    张小梅点了点头，扶着梯子慢慢爬下去——她的右膝旧伤还在，蹲下去得扶墙，但爬梯子没问题，只是不能像从前那样利索。

    林霜站在原地，又看了一眼北面那片黑暗。

    她总觉得哪里不对。矿区的灯全灭了——如果是为了隐蔽，为什么要在半夜才灭？如果在转移什么人，为什么要搞这么大的动静？还是说，矿区里发生了什么他们无法控制的事情？

    她把这两个信息记在心里，从屋顶上下来。

    ## 二、自由集市

    自由集市在工厂南边约三十公里处，在一个废弃的采石场里。

    林霜走了将近六个小时才到。她刻意放慢了速度，每走一段就停下来观察四周——不是因为体力不够，而是因为她想在路上看看有没有人被跟踪或者被埋伏。

    没有。一切正常。废土上安静得像一座巨大的坟墓。

    采石场的入口是一个宽阔的斜坡，两侧堆着几十年前开采时留下的碎石堆。碎石堆上有人用木头和铁皮搭了几个简易的棚子——那是集市的“门面“，卖东西的人坐在棚子里，把货物摆在面前的地上。

    林霜走进集市的时候，大约有三十多个人在里面。有的在讨价还价，有的蹲在角落里吃东西，有的靠在石壁上打盹。

    她先沿着集市的边缘走了一圈，观察每一个人的面孔、衣着、携带的物品，以及他们看她的眼神。

    大部分人对她没兴趣——一个穿着破烂、背着弩、脸上有疤的女人，在废土上太常见了。但也有几个人多看了她几眼，目光在她的弩上停留了一下——这是一把好东西，值不少钱。

    林霜在一个卖干货的摊位前停下来。

    摊主是一个六十多岁的老头，满脸皱纹，嘴里叼着一根自制的烟卷，眯着眼看她。

    “买什么？“

    “不买。打听点事。“

    “打听事要收钱。“

    林霜从口袋里掏出一块压缩饼干——是方晴带来的那种，包装完好，在废土上是硬通货——放在摊位上。

    老头看了一眼饼干，眼睛亮了一下，但脸上没有表情。他把饼干塞进衣服内兜，用沙哑的声音说：“问。“

    “最近有没有人在打听清泉镇的人？“

    老头的眉毛动了一下。

    “有。“

    “什么人？“

    “男人。三个。三十多岁，四十岁。穿得不像掠夺者，但也不像好人。他们在集市里转了两天，逢人就问'清泉镇有没有跑出来的人'。“

    “他们现在在哪？“

    “昨天走了。往北去了。“老头把烟卷从嘴里取下来，在鞋底上磕了磕灰，“姑娘，我劝你别打听这些人。他们不是来找人的——是来找东西的。“

    “什么东西？“

    “不知道。但他们说话的时候，我听到一个词——'种子'。“老头重新把烟卷叼回嘴里，“清泉镇有种东西，值钱的。比人命还值钱。“

    林霜没有再多问。她从摊位上站起来，在集市里又转了一圈。

    她找到了老头说的那三个人留下的痕迹——一堆烟头，牌子是战前的“红塔山“，在废土上属于奢侈品。还有几个脚印，鞋码大，纹路深，是军靴的印记。

    军靴。红塔山烟。向北去了。

    林霜把这些信息记在心里，然后离开了集市。

    ## 三、归途

    回工厂的路上，林霜走了一条不同的路线——绕了一个大弯，经过一片她从未去过的建筑废墟。

    废墟是一个居民小区，战前大概有十几栋六层楼房，现在全部坍塌了，只剩下几堵残墙和堆积如山的碎砖。林霜本来只是想抄近路，但她经过一栋相对完整的建筑时，看到了一个东西。

    一扇门。铁门，门上有锁。不是那种挂在外面的锁，而是焊在门框上的插销锁，从外面打不开。

    但门没有被打开过的痕迹。这意味着——里面可能还有人。

    林霜蹲下来，把耳朵贴在门上听。

    里面有声音。很轻的、规律的、像什么东西在敲击地面的声音——哒、哒、哒。

    林霜站起来，看了看那把锁。是普通的插销锁，铁质的，锁舌已经锈了。她用石斧砸了三下，锁舌断了。门开了。

    门后是一条向下的楼梯，六级台阶。台阶上积了一层灰，但没有脚印——这个人很久没有从地下室里出来过了。她是怎么活下来的？

    林霜走下楼梯，手电筒的光照亮了地下室。

    一个年轻的女人蜷缩在墙角，身上裹着一床发霉的被子。她的头发很长，打结，沾满了灰尘。她的脸瘦得颧骨突出，嘴唇干裂，眼睛半闭着。她的右手在地上反复敲击——哒、哒、哒——那是她唯一的求救方式。

    “你是谁？“林霜蹲下来，手电筒的光从她脸上移开——太刺眼了。

    那个女人的嘴唇翕动了几下，发出沙哑的、几乎听不清的声音。

    “水……“

    林霜从背包里拿出水壶，拧开盖子，把水倒进壶盖里，递到她嘴边。那个女人像动物一样凑过来，嘴唇碰到水面的瞬间就开始猛吸，发出咕咚咕咚的吞咽声。

    “慢点。慢慢喝。“林霜把壶盖拿开，等她咽下去，再倒第二口。

    喝了三口之后，那个女人的眼睛睁开了一些。瞳孔涣散，但开始慢慢聚焦。

    “你叫什么？“

    “……沈……沈雨。“

    “谁把你锁在这里的？“

    沈雨的嘴唇颤抖了一下。她没有回答，但眼泪从眼角滑落，在满是灰尘的脸上冲出两道白印。

    林霜没有再问。她把沈雨从地上扶起来——沈雨的体重轻得吓人，像一把干柴。她的腿站不稳，整个人靠在林霜身上。

    “能走吗？“

    “不……不知道。“

    “试试。“

    林霜扶着沈雨走上楼梯，走出铁门，走到外面的阳光下。沈雨被阳光刺得闭上眼睛，但嘴角微微上扬——那是久不见光的人接触到阳光时，本能的、细微的快乐。
    第(1/3)页

​ ## 1. Wind

At four o'clock in the morning, Lin Shuang was awakened by a slight noise.

She opened her eyes, lay in the dark for a few seconds, then sat up.She glanced next to her - Su Lin and Zhao Xiaohe were still sleeping, but Zhang Xiaomei was not there.Zhang Xiaomei's sleeping bunk was empty, and the machete was not on the wall.

Lin Shuang picked up the crossbow, walked out of the factory quietly, and climbed onto the roof.

Zhang Xiaomei stood behind the parapet of the roof, holding a telescope in her hand and looking north.Her right knee was slightly bent and she didn't dare to stand completely straight. It was a habitual posture left by an old injury.

"What did you see?" Lin Shuang walked over.

"All the lights in the mining area have gone out." Zhang Xiaomei handed her the telescope, "Not a few lights, but all of them. Starting from ten o'clock last night, they went out one by one, and now it is completely dark."

Lin Shuang looked through the binoculars.On the northern horizon, the yellow light area that looked like a small town has now turned into darkness.Only in the direction of the entrance to the mining area, there is an occasional flash of light - like a flashlight or car headlight moving.

"What are they doing?" Zhang Xiaomei put down the telescope, "It's not a power outage. They have generators."

"Maybe they are doing an exercise." Lin Shuang said, "Maybe they are transferring someone. Maybe - they discovered something and they are strengthening their concealment."

“Should we act in advance?”

"No. The plan remains unchanged. Today you go to the Free Market - no, I will go to the Free Market by myself. You take people to scout the outskirts of the mining area, but don't get close, watch from a distance. Come back before dark."

Zhang Xiaomei glanced at her: "Are you going to the Free Market alone? There are a lot of people there, so if you encounter the Reaper's informant——"

"So I will go alone. A person has a small target and can run fast." Lin Shuang returned the telescope to Zhang Xiaomei, "You take Zhao Xiaohe and Wang Fang to the north. Zhao Xiaohe's left shoulder is still recovering, but walking and climbing is no problem. Wang Fang is responsible for carrying supplies."

Zhang Xiaomei nodded and slowly climbed down the ladder - she still had an old injury on her right knee and had to hold on to the wall when she squatted down, but there was no problem in climbing the ladder, but she couldn't be as neat as before.

Lin Shuang stood there and took another look at the darkness to the north.

She always felt something was wrong.All the lights in the mining area were turned off - if it was for concealment, why were they turned off in the middle of the night?If someone is being transferred, why is there such a big fuss?Or is there something happening in the mining area that is beyond their control?

She kept these two pieces of information in mind and came down from the roof.

​​ ## 2. Free Market

The free market is about thirty kilometers south of the factory, in an abandoned quarry.

Lin Shuang walked for nearly six hours before arriving.She deliberately slowed down and stopped to look around every step of the way - not because she was not physically strong enough, but because she wanted to see if anyone was being followed or ambushed on the road.

No.Everything works fine.The wasteland was as quiet as a huge tomb.

The entrance to the quarry is a wide slope, with piles of rubble left from mining decades ago on both sides.On the rubble pile, someone built a few simple sheds out of wood and iron sheets - they were the "facade" of the market. The sellers sat in the sheds and placed their goods on the ground in front of them.

When Lin Shuang walked into the market, there were about thirty people inside.Some were bargaining, some were squatting in the corner eating, and some were taking a nap against the stone wall.

She first walked around the edge of the market, observing everyone's faces, clothes, items they carried, and the way they looked at her.

Most people are not interested in her - a woman wearing rags, carrying a crossbow and having scars on her face is too common in the wasteland.But a few people looked at her a few more times, and their eyes lingered on her crossbow - it was a good thing and worth a lot of money.

Lin Shuang stopped in front of a stall selling dry goods.

The stall owner was an old man in his sixties, with a wrinkled face and a homemade cigarette in his mouth, squinting at her.

"What to buy?"

“Don’t buy it. Ask some questions.”

“You have to pay for asking.”

Lin Shuang took out a piece of compressed biscuit from his pocket - the kind brought by Fang Qing, well packaged, which is hard currency in the wasteland - and placed it on the stall.

The old man glanced at the biscuits and his eyes lit up, but his face showed no expression.He stuffed the biscuits into his inner pocket and said in a hoarse voice: "Ask."

"Has anyone been asking about anyone in Qingquan Town recently?"

The old man’s eyebrows moved.

"Yes."

"Who?"

"Men. Three. They are in their thirties or forties. They don't dress like predators, but they don't look like good people either. They wandered around the market for two days, and when they met, they asked everyone, 'Is there anyone who escaped from Qingquan Town?'"

"Where are they now?"

"I left yesterday. To the north." The old man took the cigarette out of his mouth and knocked ashes on the soles of his shoes. "Girl, I advise you not to inquire about these people. They are not looking for people - they are looking for things."

"What?"

"I don't know. But when they were talking, I heard a word - 'seed'." The old man put the cigarette back into his mouth again, "There is something in Qingquan Town that is valuable. More valuable than human life."

Lin Shuang didn’t ask any more questions.She stood up from the stall and walked around the market again.

She found the traces left by the three people the old man mentioned - a pile of cigarette butts with the pre-war brand name "Hongta Mountain", which was a luxury item in the wasteland.There are also several footprints, with large shoe sizes and deep lines, which are the marks of military boots.

Military boots.Hongta Mountain smoke.Went north.

Lin Shuang kept this information in mind and left the market.

​​ ## 3. The way home

On the way back to the factory, Lin Shuang took a different route - taking a big detour and passing through a ruined building that she had never been to before.

The ruins are a residential area. There were about a dozen six-story buildings before the war. Now they have all collapsed, leaving only a few broken walls and mountains of broken bricks.Lin Shuang originally just wanted to take a shortcut, but when she passed a relatively complete building, she saw something.

A door.Iron door with lock.It's not the kind of lock that hangs on the outside, but a deadbolt lock that's welded to the door frame and can't be opened from the outside.

But there was no sign that the door had been opened.That means there might be someone inside.

Lin Shuang knelt down and put his ear to the door to listen.

There are sounds inside.A very light, regular sound, like something hitting the ground - click, click, click.

Lin Shuang stood up and looked at the lock.It was an ordinary latch lock, made of iron, and the bolt was rusty.She hit it three times with a stone ax and the lock bolt broke.The door opened.

Behind the door is a downward staircase with six steps.There was a layer of dust on the steps, but no footprints - the man had not been out of the basement for a long time.How did she survive?

Lin Shuang walked down the stairs, the light of the flashlight illuminated the basement.

A young woman was huddled in the corner, wrapped in a moldy quilt.Her hair was long, knotted, and covered in dust.Her face was so thin that her cheekbones protruded, her lips were chapped, and her eyes were half-closed.Her right hand struck the ground repeatedly—tap, tap, tap—and that was her only way to cry for help.

"Who are you?" Lin Shuang squatted down and the light of the flashlight moved away from her face - it was too dazzling.

The woman’s lips moved a few times and she made a hoarse, almost inaudible sound.

"Water..."

Lin Shuang took out the kettle from her backpack, unscrewed the lid, poured water into the lid, and handed it to her mouth.The woman came closer like an animal, and the moment her lips touched the water, she began to suck hard, making a gulping sound.

"Slow down. Drink slowly." Lin Shuang took the lid off the pot and waited for her to swallow before pouring the second sip.

After three sips, the woman's eyes opened a little.The pupils were dilated, but slowly began to focus.

"What's your name?"

"...Shen...Shen Yu."

"Who locked you here?"

Shen Yu's lips trembled.She didn't answer, but tears fell from the corners of her eyes, leaving two white marks on her dusty face.

Lin Shuang didn’t ask again.She helped Shen Yu up from the ground - Shen Yu's weight was frighteningly light, like a handful of dry firewood.Her legs were unsteady and she leaned on Lin Shuang.

"Can I leave?"

“No…I don’t know.”

"Try it."

Lin Shuang helped Shen Yu up the stairs, walked out of the iron gate, and walked out into the sunshine.Chen Yu was stung by the sunlight and closed her eyes, but the corners of her mouth were slightly raised - that was the instinctive and subtle happiness that comes when someone who has not seen the light for a long time comes into contact with the sun.
